Converted from the published shapefile to GeoJSON, reprojected from the shapefile's native EPSG:27700 (British National Grid) to WGS84 with scripts/reproject-datazone-boundary.mts (the atlas has no shapefile reader and every other boundary release in the catalog is WGS84), then compiled to TopoJSON. The intermediate reprojected GeoJSON is ~80MB, too large to check in, so only this compiled topology is kept; compile-boundaries.mts reads it directly, the same as superOutputArea/2011-ni.
